label: Allow only RLS-protected learner metadata review

execute.sql: GRANT UPDATE (metadata) ON TABLE public."SourceMaterial" TO authenticated

precheck.description: ensure RLS policy "source_material_review_update_guard_cd84f83e" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "source_material_review_update_guard_cd84f83e" ON "public"."SourceMaterial" AS RESTRICTIVE FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING ((current_setting('learnly.api_write', true) = '1')) WITH CHECK ((current_setting('learnly.api_write', true) = '1'))

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

precheck.description: ensure RLS policy "source_material_review_update_own_c072fcc3" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "source_material_review_update_own_c072fcc3" ON "public"."SourceMaterial" AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (("status" = 'READY' AND "type" IN ('PDF', 'IMAGE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "LearningSession" s JOIN "User" u ON u.id = s."userId" WHERE s.id = "SourceMaterial"."learningSessionId" AND u."authUserId" = (SELECT auth.uid())::text AND s."lifecycleState" = 'ACTIVE' AND s."stage" = 'EXPLAIN' AND s."version" = 0 AND s."state" IN ('INPUT', 'PRE_TEST')))) WITH CHECK (("status" = 'READY' AND "type" IN ('PDF', 'IMAGE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "LearningSession" s JOIN "User" u ON u.id = s."userId" WHERE s.id = "SourceMaterial"."learningSessionId" AND u."authUserId" = (SELECT auth.uid())::text AND s."lifecycleState" = 'ACTIVE' AND s."stage" = 'EXPLAIN' AND s."version" = 0 AND s."state" IN ('INPUT', 'PRE_TEST'))))

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"
